criteria.requirement: Genuine RGBA (PNG color type 6) with a real partial-alpha edge, not RGB with a baked matte.
criteria.measured: 4/4 color type 6; semi-alpha 2787-4812 px per file

criteria.requirement: Zero background/checker/matte residue: no fully transparent pixel carries non-zero RGB.
The figure never contacts the canvas border on any of the four edges.
Upper-body/torso framing: a shared deterministic bottom cut, not a grounded full-body figure.
criteria.measured: all four terminate at y=359 with a soft final row (max alpha 136-140) and zero alpha at y>=360; bottom margin 152 px in 4/4

criteria.requirement: Each class silhouette is distinct from every other; specifically Rogue must not reuse the Reaver silhouette, the exact failure recorded in the 2026-08-28 preflight.
criteria.measured: no two alpha>=128 masks identical; pairwise IoU 0.6533-0.7990; reaver vs rogue IoU 0.7052

criteria.requirement: Deterministic desktop and mobile context proofs exist at fixed viewports.
The packet stays proof-only and disabled: no adoption, mapping, integration or release.
criteria.measured: hub records 'Proof Accepted · Not Adopted', future looks 4 proof-only/disabled; no repository code path reads assets/classes/**

fails_if: Any crop is replaced by RGB bytes, a baked checkerboard, or a masked/segmented derivative of the rejected 1254x1254 concept package or of reaver-alpha-retry-rejected.png.
Any crop contacts a canvas edge, or the shared y=359 bottom cut moves for one class only.
Any two class alpha masks become identical, or Rogue is regenerated from the Reaver rig.
Any file byte, SHA-256 or git blob in successor_packet changes: the packet is frozen, so a hash change is a break, not an update.
The packet is adopted, mapped into a reader/manifest, integrated, pushed, merged, deployed, published or released under D1, which authorizes none of these.

evidence_pin.why: The Hub rebuild 3e98769e removed review-approval-hub/evidence/** from the tree; origin/dev holds 0 files there. The packet bytes survive as git objects reachable from this commit. Every read below binds to a git object, never to a working-tree path, so this contract verifies the same bytes in any clone that has the objects — including one where the paths no longer exist.
evidence_pin.read_order: git_blob OID first (content-addressed, path-independent); 62f6867a:<path> as fallback when no OID is recorded.
